mechanism: Build an immutable, generation-tagged routed-expert descriptor snapshot from currently resident LRU entries and execute one selected direct-u8 PQ projection through device-owned expert IDs and execution slots.

snapshot_contract.source: Currently resident entries in the existing name-keyed BoundedLru while the caller owns its cache guard.
snapshot_contract.ready_rule: An expert entry is ready only when gate, up, and down are all device-resident and all backing Metal handles are cloned into the immutable lease.
snapshot_contract.lease: Cloned Buffer handles outlive logical LRU eviction and are retained through command completion.
snapshot_contract.indirect_resource_declaration: Every leased backing Buffer is passed to MTLComputeCommandEncoder.useResources with read usage before raw-address dereference.

device_validation.miss_output: One u32 mask indexed by execution position.

numeric_parity_v2_1.authority: Complete 32-value FP64 dense matvec over the exact f16 codebook values addressed by the direct-u8 descriptor.

qualified: The cache-indexed raw-address ABI is accepted by Rust and Metal.
A resident direct-u8 projection can be chosen entirely from device IDs and execution slots.
The resource lease remains valid after the corresponding logical cache entry is evicted.
A missing selected triplet is detected before dereference and the projection destination is not mutated.
not_qualified: This proof is not wired into production forward.
Only one PQ projection is executed indirectly; gate/up/SiLU/down/combine/shared-last/residual are not yet a table-driven wave.
Native-bf16 indirect execution is tagged but not executed by this PQ kernel.
The miss proof covers the projection destination, not yet the complete pre-layer residual and trace contract.
qualification.next_boundary: Extend the same validated hit predicate across gate, up, SiLU, down, routed weighted combine, shared-last, and guarded residual mutation in one command buffer; preserve an exact typed miss before any output is consumed.
